cases.prompt: I have a Claude Code slash command at `.claude/commands/changelog.md`. Its body uses `$ARGUMENTS` for the user input and embeds git output inline with `` !`git log --oneline -20` ``. I want to port this same command to the Gemini CLI. Tell me exactly what to change and where the file goes.

expect.criterion: States the ported file must use the `.toml` extension and live in `.gemini/commands/` (project) or `~/.gemini/commands/` (user)
Converts the argument placeholder from `$ARGUMENTS` to `{{args}}`
Puts the body into a triple-quoted multiline `prompt = """..."""` TOML key and converts inline shell from `` !`cmd` `` to `!{cmd}`

cases.prompt: We have a ~140-line Claude Code slash command that inlines its entire Goal, Workflow, Output format, and Gotchas. I want to refactor it into a thin command that keeps only its argument contract and delegates the actual procedure to a reusable guideline skill. It's packaged as a plugin. Walk me through every step so nothing breaks at run time.

expect.criterion: Says to add the `Skill` tool to the command's `allowed-tools` so the delegation can load the skill
Says to declare the guideline skill as a dependency in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and to distribute the skill directly for Codex instead of creating a parallel command manifest

Keeps the argument contract (flags/defaults) in the command while the Goal/Workflow/Output/Gotchas move into the skill's `references/{operation}.md`, and notes install does not equal in-context (must load via the Skill tool)

cases.prompt: I just finished a task where I stripped every `console.log` call out of `packages/billing-service/src/` for our invoicing app. Save this as a reusable slash command I can run on other projects.

expect.criterion: Replaces the project-specific path `packages/billing-service/src/` and domain/app terms (billing, invoicing) with generic equivalents rather than hardcoding them
Gives the command a kebab-case name
Creates or selects one owner skill for the reusable procedure and keeps the resulting command thin with frontmatter, Arguments, and Delegation rather than embedding the workflow

cases.prompt: Create a Claude command for repository release checks. The procedure is owned by managing-versions in plugin xonovex-core, and it can optionally use any installed changelog capability. Preview everything because a command with that name already exists.

expect.criterion: Keeps managing-versions as the owner skill and xonovex-core as the separate distribution plugin instead of conflating their names
Describes changelog support as an optional runtime capability selected from installed skill names and descriptions rather than making a second skill co-own the command or copying its instructions
Uses dry-run to preview the command, owner-skill reference, and manifest changes and refuses to overwrite the existing command without an explicit exact-target force choice

cases.prompt: Distill this fat deploy command. Keep its existing flags exactly, move the procedure to the promote operation of deploying-services, require the xonovex-skill-deploy plugin, and let runtime select separate observability and rollback helpers.

expect.criterion: Preserves the existing public argument names, defaults, and repeatability in the thin command
Moves procedure, output, errors, and gotchas to the promote operation of deploying-services and explicitly loads that owner at runtime
Wires xonovex-skill-deploy as the owner plugin dependency while describing observability and rollback as optional supporting capabilities selected at runtime

cases.prompt: Simplify this 90-line Claude command. It already delegates to releasing-packages but repeats the workflow of that skill, validation, and errors in the command body.

expect.criterion: Preserves metadata, arguments, supporting-capability prose, exact owner plugin, and operation as the public command contract
Removes duplicated procedure from the command and keeps or moves it into the registered releasing-packages operation
Validates argument parity, operation registration, dependencies, and tool permissions instead of preserving a fat workflow to hit a percentage target

cases.prompt: Merge the safety and validation behavior from source.md into target.md. Both are skill-delegating commands, but they currently name different owner skills.

expect.criterion: Treats the two owner skills as an ownership conflict and requires one procedure owner before merging
Merges compatible public arguments or supporting-capability prose into the command while moving reusable safety and validation behavior into the selected owner operation
Does not inline the source workflow into the target command or silently widen tools and effects
